data.one_liner: Call native applications to open files with string results across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to trigger native apps to open specific files using platform-specific mechanisms like intents on Android, DocumentInteraction on iOS, ffi on PC, and dart:html on the web. It returns the result as a string.
use_when: You need to let users open downloaded files or documents inside native applications.
You need cross-platform file opening support covering Android, iOS, PC, and web.
avoid_when: You need to parse or view files directly inside the Flutter UI rather than launching an external app.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including mobile, desktop, and web.
Handles automatic type and UTI retrieval for common file formats.
weaknesses: May require manual Android FileProvider configuration adjustments if conflicts occur with other plugins.
Relies entirely on external native applications installed on the device to view files.
data.setup_notes: May require configuring Android FileProvider XML paths in AndroidManifest.xml if conflicts with other plugins occur.
